name: R5 지시 점검
instruction:
Hook data: {{hooks.tag-instruction.data}}
If the hook data says done_condition is "no", set verdict to "stop" and give the reason "완료 조건이 없습니다. 끝났다고 판단할 기준을 덧붙여 다시 보내 주세요." Otherwise do not stop; put "Pixie 요약: " followed by the hook summary in append, and put "R5 input gate ran" in note.

name: R5 파일 결과
instruction:
Line count from the hook: {{hooks.only-gate-file.text}}
Do not stop and do not replace. Put exactly "[PIXIE CHECKED <line count> lines] gate-sample.txt was reviewed by Pixie Gate." in append, using the hook line count.

name: R5 답변 점검
instruction: Look only at the last non-empty line of the final answer. If that line is not exactly GATE-OK, set verdict "stop" with reason "답변 마지막 줄에 GATE-OK를 쓰고 다시 마무리하세요." (mentions of GATE-OK elsewhere do not count). If the last line is exactly GATE-OK, pass and put "GATE-OK confirmed" in note.
